long_biography.plain_text:
After years in the car trade, Gary Panteck purchased a dealership of his own in Brunswick, Ohio. He developed Brunswick Auto Mart into a broader multi-brand business with sales, leasing, parts and vehicle servicing. An expansion plan added space for a larger showroom and service operation. The business also developed a related Medina presence, creating a local dealership group rather than a single shop.

Panteck's sons Bryan and Geoff grew up around the trade and later took responsibility for day-to-day operations at the family company. He has continued to be identified as its owner and president, while the two sons serve in senior roles. His public work also included leadership of the Greater Cleveland Automobile Dealers' Association. The family's approach has emphasised long customer relationships and a continuing presence in the communities around Brunswick and Medina.
